title: Reflecting on and Recording Achievements
text: Recognise everything you have achieved so far in life and understand how reflecting on achievements can support future education and career decisions.
cdi_links: 4.G.04 Reflecting on and recording achievements, experiences and learning

title: Introduction
text: In this lesson, you will explore
bullets: What achievements are and why they matter
How recognising achievements supports career planning

title: Success Criteria
bullets: I can explain what aspirations are
I can describe the meaning of self-reflection
I can explain how reflecting on achievements supports future goals

title: Key Words
bullets: Aspirations – Hopes or ambitions for the future, especially related to life or career.
Self-Reflection – Thinking deeply about your actions, feelings, and what you have learned.

title: Quick Questions
text: Think about something you are proud of achieving.
Did you face any challenges along the way?
How might this achievement help you in the future?

title: Learning – Self Reflection
bullets: Self-reflection means thinking about what you have done and what you learned from it.
Achievements show your effort, skills, and values.
Even small successes can tell you something important about yourself.
Reflecting on experiences helps you plan future goals and career ideas.

title: Story – Just Getting There
text: Jay woke up on the morning of an important exam. Things did not go as planned – he was short on time, the weather was bad, and small problems kept appearing.
Despite this, he kept going and arrived at school just in time.
By the time the exam began, he realised something important.
The real achievement had been overcoming the obstacles and making it there.

title: Activity 1
text:
Your Proudest Achievements
List the school achievements that have meant the most to you. They do not have to be huge successes. Sometimes small goals can mean a lot.

title: Activity 2
text:
Self Reflection
Choose one achievement and answer the following questions:
What was my achievement?
What challenges did I face?
What or who helped me succeed?
How does this support my education or career goals?

title: Complete the sentence
sentence: Self-reflection helps us understand our ______ and plan our ______ goals.

title: Key Takeaways
text: Achievements show effort, skills, and personal growth
Self-reflection helps you understand what you have learned
Thinking about achievements can help guide future education and career plans
